## Before Students Arrive (9:45)

```{=typst}
#checkbox Open slides on main screen (week11/lab/slides.qmd)

#checkbox Check Qualtrics survey is live and QR code works

#checkbox Set out at each station:
#h(1em) #checkbox Station 1 (Reflex): Rulers (30cm)
#h(1em) #checkbox Station 2 (Time Warp): Stopwatch, line cards, strings
#h(1em) #checkbox Station 3 (Sixth Sense): Coins
#h(1em) #checkbox Station 4 (Lady Luck): Dice, coins
#h(1em) #checkbox Station 5 (Frontal Lob): Ping pong balls, basket

#checkbox Sequence cards ready to hand out

#checkbox Spare pens and paper for memory test recall
```

---

## Session Flow

### 10:00 — Welcome & Setup (10 min)

```{=typst}
#checkbox Welcome students, explain DataLab purpose

#checkbox Students collect sequence cards (hand out in order!)

#checkbox Students form pairs (same colour on card)

#checkbox Students scan QR and start Part 1 survey

#checkbox Tell them: *"STOP when you reach the Memory Test page"*
```

### 10:10 — Memory Test (15 min)

```{=typst}
#box(fill: luma(230), inset: 8pt, radius: 4pt, width: 100%)[
  *YOUR LAB:* #h(2em) #box(stroke: 1pt, inset: 4pt)[304A — Mozart + Abstract] #h(1em) OR #h(1em) #box(stroke: 1pt, inset: 4pt)[304B — Silence + Concrete]
]

#v(4pt)

#checkbox Announce: *"Look LEFT"* or *"Look RIGHT"* (split the room)

#checkbox Advance to YOUR lab's word list slide

#checkbox STUDY phase: Start 30-second timer (on slide)
#h(1em) Students memorise their word list silently

#checkbox DISTRACT phase: Advance to maths slide, start 60-second timer
#h(1em) Students do maths problems (no calculators!)

#checkbox RECALL phase: Advance to recall slide, start 90-second timer
#h(1em) Students write words on paper — NO looking at screen!

#checkbox Students enter results in Qualtrics (words recalled, positions, intrusions, strategy)
```

### 10:25 — Tasks Begin (80 min)

```{=typst}
#checkbox Announce: *"Check your sequence card, go to your first station"*

#checkbox Start 15-minute timer for each rotation

#checkbox Circulate — help with any confusion

#checkbox Remind students: *"Enter data in Qualtrics before moving!"*

#box(fill: luma(240), inset: 6pt, radius: 4pt, width: 100%)[
  *Rotation times:* 10:25 → 10:40 → 10:55 → 11:10 → 11:25 → 11:40
]
```

### 11:45 — Wrap-up (15 min)

```{=typst}
#checkbox Announce: *"Return to your seats for Part 2 survey"*

#checkbox Students complete Part 2 (mood POST, favourites, comments)

#checkbox Quick debrief — preview Week 12 analysis

#checkbox Check all Qualtrics submissions complete
```

---

## Key Reminders

```{=typst}
#box(fill: rgb("#fff3cd"), inset: 10pt, radius: 4pt, width: 100%)[
  *Memory Test:*
  - 304A = Abstract words + Mozart playing
  - 304B = Concrete words + Silence
  - Make sure students only look at THEIR list (left or right)
]

#v(6pt)

#box(fill: rgb("#d1ecf1"), inset: 10pt, radius: 4pt, width: 100%)[
  *Common Issues:*
  - Students forgetting to enter data before moving → remind them!
  - Pairs getting separated → keep same-colour pairs together
  - Qualtrics not loading → have backup paper forms ready
]
```

## Station Reference

| Station | What They Do | Key Variables |
|---------|--------------|---------------|
| 1. Reflex | Catch falling ruler ×5 | Distance (cm) → RT (ms) |
| 2. Time Warp | Estimate 60s, lines, strings, temp | Estimation errors |
| 3. Sixth Sense | Detect staring ×6 | Hits, false alarms |
| 4. Lady Luck | 20 random numbers, dice, coins | Patterns, runs |
| 5. Frontal Lob | Rate ability, throw ×10 | Calibration |
